fundamentals.name: HubSpot, Inc.
fundamentals.longBusinessSummary: HubSpot, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, provides a cloud-based customer relationship management (CRM) platform for businesses in the Americas, Europe, and the Asia Pacific. The company's CRM platform includes Marketing Hub, a toolset for marketing automation and email, social media, SEO, AEO, and reporting and analytics; Sales Hub offers email templates and tracking, conversations and live chat, meeting and call scheduling, lead and website visit alerts, lead scoring, sales automation, pipeline management, quoting, forecasting, and reporting; Service Hub, a service software designed to help businesses manage, respond, and connect with customers; and Content Hub that helps business with website pages, business blogging, video and podcast hosting, smart content, landing pages and forms, SEO recommendations, forms and lead flow, web analytics reporting, calls-to-action, and file manager. It offers Operations Hub, which provides programmable automation, data sync, data curation, and data quality tools; and Commerce Hub, a B2B commerce suite that provides payment links, invoices, quotes, subscription management, and automation and revenue reporting; and breeze, an AI that powers the customer platform that provides AI-powered insights, automation, content generation, and data enrichment, as well as Breeze Assistant, a go-to-market assistant to boost productivity and make work easier; and Breeze Agents, which helps teams automate work end-to-end from strategy to execution. In addition, the company provides professional services to educate and train customers on how to utilize its CRM platform; and customer success; phone and/or email and chat-based support services; and helps customers by providing Customer Success Manager and Partner Development Manager digital channels through educational content academey. It serves mid-market business-to-business companies. The company was incorporated in 2005 and is headquartered in Cambridge, Massachusetts.

judgment.summary: Fast-growing software company with strong revenue expansion, high margins, and a reasonable forward P/E, though debt levels warrant monitoring.
judgment.earningsRecap: Last quarter beat EPS estimates by 10.2%; next earnings date is 2026-08-05.
positives: Revenue growth 23.4% YoY, with analyst estimates for current Q and FY above 35%.
Gross margin at 83.7% indicates strong pricing power and efficient operations.
Forward P/E of 13.63x is attractive relative to trailing P/E of 111.99x and PEG ratio of 0.35.
Free cash flow of $656.18M TTM supports operations and potential investments.
Consensus buy rating from 33 analysts with a mean target of $280.16.
negatives: Operating and profit margins are relatively low at 3.3% and 3.0% respectively.
Return on equity (5.0%) and return on assets (1.1%) are modest.
Debt/Equity ratio of 12.38% is high, although total debt is low relative to cash.
Beta of 1.20 suggests higher volatility than the broader market.

news.paragraph: HubSpot's stock has seen significant movement, trading up 10.8% following a profitable Q1 and reported AI CRM momentum. Recent articles highlight the company as a strong growth and momentum stock, with some suggesting it may be undervalued despite recent gains. The narrative centers on AI-driven growth and a strong Q1 performance, with a consensus buy rating from analysts.
